title: Universal Type-I Functional Voxel + Field Inference Basis
purpose: Factor the 411-archetype Type-I technology matrix into reusable 3D functional regions whose geometry, material/process state, interfaces, field/topology kernels, 4D state and evidence can be composed into dense printed/hybrid systems without forcing a flat schematic or a single universal fabrication process.
factorization: Archetype ? PrimitiveKernel ? VolumetricKernel ? InterfaceOperator ? ProcessSequence ? FunctionalVoxelState ? SeedGraph ? FieldCoupling ? WitnessEvidence
non_planar_rule: A stack is a directed 3D region/interface graph with cavities, service corridors, nested/embedded volumes and optional inserted seeds. Z-order is only one possible geometry. Compilation orders process dependencies and preservation gates, not merely planar layers.

voxel_contract.revision_rule: Any consequential geometry, material, process, interface, boundary or environment revision invalidates dependent numeric matrices/results and triggers selective recompile/readback.
voxel_contract.sparse_state_rule: Store only consequential domains for a region; absent domains are omitted rather than zero-filled as fictitious physics.

assembly.local_residual_form: R_k(z_k, zdot_k, u_k, p_k, t)=0 within each child-domain model and validity regime
assembly.interface_constraint_form: g_ij(z_i,z_j,p_ij,t)=0 for declared UTP-141 interface operators
assembly.coupled_descriptor: E(z,p,t)·zdot = F(z,u,p,t) is an assembly descriptor only; it is not a replacement for domain-specific governing physics.

capacitance_selector.evidence_class: ENGINEERING_INFERENCE until WIT-002 calibrated readback promotes an exact instance

modes.numeric_gate: exact electrode overlap, dielectric thickness/state and epsilon_r at declared frequency/T/RH; fringe negligible or corrected

modes.topology: series dielectric layers normal to dominant field
modes.numeric_gate: common effective area, attributable layer thickness/permittivity and valid quasi-static approximation; interfaces/voids handled separately
cells share the same two electrical nodes; parasitic/mutual coupling does not invalidate simple sum
b>a>0, homogeneous/known dielectric and end effects negligible or corrected
electrostatic boundary-value solve with attributable geometry/material/interface state and declared reference convention

modes.law: use topology-valid per-unit-length C' within R'L'G'C' model
modes.numeric_gate: cross-section/material/boundary/frequency regime attributable; no forced lumped approximation

modes.law: no universal closed form; resolve electrostatic field/matrix or measure
modes.numeric_gate: HOLD numeric closed-form inference unless a validated geometry-specific approximation exists

boundaries: dielectric strength is a separate source/test property and is not inferred from C
loss, leakage, ESR, ESL, breakdown, lifetime and certification are not inferred from geometry-only capacitance
measured C must retain frequency, amplitude/bias, fixture, T/RH and uncertainty
geometry/material/process revision invalidates stale capacitance inference

reusable_per_unit_basis.gate: exact cured/source electrical property + contacts + geometry

reusable_per_unit_basis.law: R=Rs*L/W ; P=I^2*R=V^2/R ; tau≈Rtheta*Ctheta when lumped model valid
L≈mu*N^2*A/l only when topology/regime supports; Q≈omega*L/Rseries
tau=J*alpha+tau_load+tau_loss ; tau≈Kt*I only when source model applies
reusable_per_unit_basis.gate: complete load/axis envelope + exact actuator model

reusable_per_unit_basis.law: DeltaP=8*mu*L*Q/(pi*r^4) only for fully developed laminar circular tube
y=H(x,state,t)+bias+noise ; S=d y/d x from source/calibration

type1_system_rule: Type-I scale is achieved by composing qualified local regions and serviceable modules into infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, sensing/control, transport, habitat/environmental and space-logistics systems. Scale does not relax component, interface, process, witness or safety evidence gates.
safety_invariants: safe-state/fault-containment is explicit where consequence requires it
service and metrology access are engineered volumetric regions, not leftover space
trapped electrical/thermal/pressure/chemical energy must have a declared isolation/discharge/containment path before BUILD_READY
process ordering cannot cross predecessor damage envelopes
identity/provenance does not grant execution/certification/release authority
advanced silicon/MEMS/precision optoelectronics/certified protection remain seed/hybrid unless separately qualified

seed_field_companion.role: Resolve zero/single/multi-seed implementation graphs plus 3D parasitic, near/far-field, radiative, thermal, mechanical, fluid, chemical and ionizing-radiation coupling without flattening the physical stack into a schematic.
